svg.title: C07-M01-F2: Default-deny inverts the posture
svg.desc: A comparison of the permissive allow-unless-blocked posture against the secure deny-unless-allowed posture at the network layer.
svg.text: allow-unless-blocked (BAD): everything flows; you chase exceptions
deny-unless-allowed (GOOD): nothing flows; you permit only what is needed
firewall ends with "deny all"; segmentation permits only listed flows
Figure C07-M01-F2. Default-deny and least privilege turn "block what is bad" into "allow
